title: 隧道噴射混凝土支護~Shotcrete tunnel support
focus: 以早齡承載、基面黏結與厚度控制噴凝土支護~Control shotcrete support through early strength, substrate bond and installed thickness
summary: 本課以以早齡承載、基面黏結與厚度控制噴凝土支護為主線，從薄殼受力與岩面接觸與早齡強度與卸載時序建立系統邊界，再把鋼筋網背後的陰影區、芯樣方向與強度換算連到分區品質與交接證據。噴層與岩塊、岩栓共同工作，空腔會改變受力路徑。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。~This course focuses on control shotcrete support through early strength, substrate bond and installed thickness. It begins with Shell action and rock contact and Early strength and unloading sequence, links Shadows behind reinforcement mesh and Core orientation and strength interpretation, and ends with Zoned quality and handover evidence. The layer interacts with rock blocks and bolts; cavities change its load path. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

units.anchor: 薄殼受力與岩面接觸~Shell action and rock contact
units.title: 薄殼受力與岩面接觸~Shell action and rock contact
units.mechanism: 黏結完整的噴層限制岩塊轉動，把局部作用傳給周圍岩體及岩栓。若岩面存在空腔，膜力路徑會局部轉成彎曲，平均壓應力合格仍可能有背面拉裂；完整圓環模型只用來辨認量級，不能代替節理岩塊的穩定分析。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將雷射斷面、敲擊空鼓圖與岩塊節理位置對齊比較；若出現未接觸區的集中彎曲造成裂紋，表面厚度正常仍可能剝落，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~A bonded layer restrains block rotation and transfers local actions to surrounding rock and bolts. Cavities convert membrane transfer into bending, allowing back-face tension despite acceptable mean compression. An intact-ring model establishes scale only and does not replace joint-block stability analysis. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare laser sections and sounding maps registered to rock-block joints. If concentrated bending over noncontact zones cracks a layer of apparently normal thickness, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：N=pR=0.10 MPa*4 m=0.40 MN/m; sigma=N/t=0.40/0.15=2.67 MPa。噴層與岩塊、岩栓共同工作，空腔會改變受力路徑。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: N=pR=0.10 MPa*4 m=0.40 MN/m; sigma=N/t=0.40/0.15=2.67 MPa. The layer interacts with rock blocks and bolts; cavities change its load path. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.
units.verify: 將雷射斷面、敲擊空鼓圖與岩塊節理位置對齊比較。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「未接觸區的集中彎曲造成裂紋，表面厚度正常仍可能剝落」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。~Compare laser sections and sounding maps registered to rock-block joints. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Concentrated bending over noncontact zones cracks a layer of apparently normal thickness. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.
units.failure: 未接觸區的集中彎曲造成裂紋，表面厚度正常仍可能剝落。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將雷射斷面、敲擊空鼓圖與岩塊節理位置對齊比較，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。~Concentrated bending over noncontact zones cracks a layer of apparently normal thickness. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare laser sections and sounding maps registered to rock-block joints to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.
units.misconception: 平均厚度足夠便不必查岩面接觸~Adequate mean thickness removes the need to check rock contact
units.practice: 將將雷射斷面、敲擊空鼓圖與岩塊節理位置對齊比較列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現未接觸區的集中彎曲造成裂紋，表面厚度正常仍可能剝落，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Compare laser sections and sounding maps registered to rock-block joints. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If concentrated bending over noncontact zones cracks a layer of apparently normal thickness, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 早齡強度與卸載時序~Early strength and unloading sequence
units.title: 早齡強度與卸載時序~Early strength and unloading sequence
units.mechanism: 凝結只是材料開始形成骨架，不代表已達長期承載。開挖卸載與噴層硬化同時發生，下一循環擾動可能作用在仍弱的拱頂；室溫試件與潮濕寒冷岩面的成熟度不同，須用齡期和溫度描述同一強度狀態。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將早齡貫入或拔釘結果與原位溫度及噴射時間配對；若出現溫暖試件高估拱頂強度，使後續擾動造成不可逆微裂縫，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Setting starts formation of a material skeleton rather than providing long-term capacity. Excavation unloading competes with hardening, and the next disturbance can reach a weak crown. Laboratory and cold wet rock-face maturity differ, so age and temperature must describe a common strength state. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Match early penetration or stud results to in-place temperature and spraying time. If warm specimens overstate crown strength and subsequent disturbance creates irreversible microcracks, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 回彈量與材料收支~Rebound and material balance
units.title: 回彈量與材料收支~Rebound and material balance
units.mechanism: 回彈物不是原配比的等比例縮小，骨材與纖維可能選擇性流失。泵送量只能描述供料，不能證明留在岩面的密度或纖維含量；材料帳應區分落地回彈、管路殘留與有效噴層，才可把厚度不足與輸送損失分開。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以分區回彈收集重量及原位密度反算留存體積；若出現回彈重新混入會引入污染並掩蓋纖維與骨材比例改變，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Rebound is not a scaled copy of the original mix because aggregate and fibres can be preferentially lost. Pumped volume does not prove installed density or fibre content. Separate rebound, line residue and retained layer so insufficient thickness can be distinguished from delivery losses. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Use zoned rebound mass and in-place density to reconstruct retained volume. If reintroduced rebound brings contamination and conceals changed fibre and aggregate proportions, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 基面黏結與破壞界面~Bond and failure interfaces
units.title: 基面黏結與破壞界面~Bond and failure interfaces
units.mechanism: 粉塵、水膜與鬆動薄片會切斷噴層和基岩之間的剪力傳遞。拉拔量到的是試體中最弱路徑，可能位於膠層、噴凝土或岩石；相同峰值不代表相同修復方法，必須保留破壞面照片和各層位置才能判讀。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐件記錄拉拔破壞面、濕度及切割邊界位置；若出現膠層剝離被錯當噴凝土失效，會導致錯誤的材料更換，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Dust, water films and loose flakes interrupt shear transfer to the substrate. A pull test samples the weakest path, which may lie in adhesive, shotcrete or rock. Equal peaks need not imply equal repairs; retain failure-face photographs and layer positions for interpretation. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Record the failure plane, moisture and isolation-cut boundary for every pull test. If adhesive debonding misclassified as shotcrete failure leads to the wrong material replacement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 鋼筋網背後的陰影區~Shadows behind reinforcement mesh
units.title: 鋼筋網背後的陰影區~Shadows behind reinforcement mesh
units.mechanism: 鋼筋網交叉點遮蔽噴流，外觀平順的表面可能蓋住相連蜂窩。網距、岩面凹凸與噴層厚度一起決定包覆難度；含網試板若沒有重現交叉節點，就只能驗材料，不能驗證現地幾何下的密實程度。 判別這個機制時，應觀察切開含相同網距的試板，統計交叉點背面的孔隙；若出現沿鋼筋連通的孔洞讓水快速進入並加速局部腐蝕，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Mesh intersections shield the stream, and a smooth face can hide connected voids. Spacing, rock roughness and thickness jointly control encapsulation. A panel without representative intersections tests material but cannot verify consolidation within the installed geometry. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Section panels with matching mesh spacing and quantify voids behind intersections. If connected voids along reinforcement admit water rapidly and accelerate local corrosion, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 局部厚度與斷面配準~Local thickness and section registration
units.title: 局部厚度與斷面配準~Local thickness and section registration
units.mechanism: 岩面起伏使同一材料體積產生不同的最薄厚度，局部彎曲與耐久往往由薄區主導。施工前後點雲必須共用控制基準，否則岩面突起會被誤讀為新增厚度；平均料量只能作總體收支，不能取代最薄處驗證。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將厚度釘、鑽芯與雙期點雲在共同基準下互比；若出現點雲錯位遮蔽薄區，造成局部剛度與保護層被高估，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Rock roughness gives different minimum thicknesses at equal material volume, while local bending and durability often depend on thin areas. Before-and-after clouds require common control; otherwise protrusions appear as added thickness. Delivered volume is a global balance rather than verification of local minima. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare thickness pins, cores and two-epoch clouds on a common datum. If cloud misregistration conceals thin zones and overstates local stiffness and cover, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：tavg=V/A=15 m3/100 m2=0.15 m; assumed local minimum=0.09 m。噴層與岩塊、岩栓共同工作，空腔會改變受力路徑。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: tavg=V/A=15 m3/100 m2=0.15 m; assumed local minimum=0.09 m. The layer interacts with rock blocks and bolts; cavities change its load path. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Cloud misregistration conceals thin zones and overstates local stiffness and cover. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare thickness pins, cores and two-epoch clouds on a common datum to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

units.practice: 將將厚度釘、鑽芯與雙期點雲在共同基準下互比列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現點雲錯位遮蔽薄區，造成局部剛度與保護層被高估，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Compare thickness pins, cores and two-epoch clouds on a common datum. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If cloud misregistration conceals thin zones and overstates local stiffness and cover, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 芯樣方向與強度換算~Core orientation and strength interpretation
units.title: 芯樣方向與強度換算~Core orientation and strength interpretation
units.mechanism: 噴凝土有層間界面，取芯方向會改變荷載穿越界面的方式。端面不平又會引入偏心壓縮，兩種效應都能降低峰值但原因不同；試體形狀、齡期與飽水狀態必須一起記錄，不能把任意立方體結果直接套到拱頂。 判別這個機制時，應觀察成組比較相同齡期但不同取芯方向的破壞形態；若出現端面偏心造成假低強度，掩蓋真正的層間黏結問題，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Sprayed layers contain interfaces whose loading depends on coring direction. Uneven ends introduce eccentric compression; both effects reduce peaks for different reasons. Record geometry, age and saturation together rather than transferring an arbitrary cube result directly to the crown. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare failure shapes of same-age cores taken in different orientations. If eccentric end loading produces false low strength and obscures actual interlayer bond problems, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：fc=F/A=200 kN/(pi*0.05^2 m2)=25.46 MPa。噴層與岩塊、岩栓共同工作，空腔會改變受力路徑。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: fc=F/A=200 kN/(pi*0.05^2 m2)=25.46 MPa. The layer interacts with rock blocks and bolts; cavities change its load path. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

units.anchor: 收斂與噴層應變零點~Convergence and strain-gauge zero
units.title: 收斂與噴層應變零點~Convergence and strain-gauge zero
units.mechanism: 地層在噴層安裝前已變形，總收斂並不全部進入噴凝土。應變計晚歸零會刪除早期荷載，溫度又能造成非機械應變；需把噴射、安裝、歸零與後續開挖放在同一時間軸，才可比較環向收縮和材料應力。 判別這個機制時，應觀察把應變、溫度、收斂及儀器歸零時刻共同對時；若出現歸零後曲線平穩卻漏掉累積應力，錯判支護已卸載，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Ground deforms before support installation, so total convergence does not all enter the lining. Late zeroing removes early load history, and temperature adds nonmechanical strain. Align spraying, installation, zeroing and excavation before comparing circumferential shortening with material stress. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Synchronize strain, temperature, convergence and gauge-zero timestamps. If a calm post-zero curve hides accumulated stress and falsely suggests unloading, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 活動裂縫與耐久通路~Active cracks and durability paths
units.title: 活動裂縫與耐久通路~Active cracks and durability paths
units.mechanism: 裂縫寬度描述某一時刻，無法單獨區分乾縮、溫度循環與岩體持續運動。水和侵蝕離子可沿裂縫優先進入，封閉表面可能把出水轉移到別處；維修判斷需追蹤同一裂縫的開合、水量及附近收斂歷史。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以裂縫計、水量、溫度和固定視角照片追蹤同一位置；若出現活動裂縫被當成乾縮封補後重新開裂並改變漏水位置，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Width describes an instant rather than distinguishing shrinkage, thermal cycling and continued rock movement. Water and aggressive ions follow cracks, while sealing a face can redirect discharge. Repair decisions need the same crack's opening, flow and neighbouring convergence history. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Track one location with crack gauges, flow, temperature and fixed-view photographs. If an active crack treated as shrinkage reopens and shifts the leakage location, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 分區品質與交接證據~Zoned quality and handover evidence
units.title: 分區品質與交接證據~Zoned quality and handover evidence
units.mechanism: 支護品質沿里程與環向都可能不同，將所有試件合併平均會失去對薄區和濕區的辨識。交接資料應連結地質、批次、噴射時刻和缺陷處置，讓後續裂紋能追溯到初期狀態，而不是只留下單一平均強度證明。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐區核對厚度、黏結、早齡強度及缺陷關閉紀錄；若出現缺少里程對應的合格報告無法證明受損區曾受檢查，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Quality varies along chainage and around the perimeter; pooling specimens conceals thin or wet zones. Link geology, batches, spraying times and defect disposition so later cracks can be traced to their initial condition rather than a single average-strength certificate. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Audit thickness, bond, early strength and defect closure by zone. If unlocated passing reports cannot establish that a damaged zone was inspected, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

If unlocated passing reports cannot establish that a damaged zone was inspected, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

example: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查薄殼受力與岩面接觸：N=pR=0.10 MPa*4 m=0.40 MN/m; sigma=N/t=0.40/0.15=2.67 MPa；再獨立檢查早齡強度與卸載時序：Inputs stress=0.60 MPa, earlyStrength=1.20 MPa; utilization=stress/earlyStrength=0.60/1.20=0.50; at earlyStrength=0.80 MPa it becomes 0.75。壓力由 0.10 增為 0.11 MPa，半徑和厚度不變，環力由 0.40 增為 0.44 MN/m，應力由 2.67 增為 2.93 MPa；這只適用完整環。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為噴層與岩塊、岩栓共同工作，空腔會改變受力路徑。 將把應變、溫度、收斂及儀器歸零時刻共同對時作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。~All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Shell action and rock contact: N=pR=0.10 MPa*4 m=0.40 MN/m; sigma=N/t=0.40/0.15=2.67 MPa. Independently check Early strength and unloading sequence: Inputs stress=0.60 MPa, earlyStrength=1.20 MPa; utilization=stress/earlyStrength=0.60/1.20=0.50; at earlyStrength=0.80 MPa it becomes 0.75. Increasing pressure from 0.10 to 0.11 MPa at fixed radius and thickness raises ring force from 0.40 to 0.44 MN/m and stress from 2.67 to 2.93 MPa, for an intact ring only. The two results are not a complete design because the layer interacts with rock blocks and bolts; cavities change its load path. Use synchronize strain, temperature, convergence and gauge-zero timestamps as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
history: 本課討論的以早齡承載、基面黏結與厚度控制噴凝土支護，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。噴層與岩塊、岩栓共同工作，空腔會改變受力路徑。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。哥達與英法海底隧道僅作地質及地下水邊界的比較，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。~The focus on control shotcrete support through early strength, substrate bond and installed thickness reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. The layer interacts with rock blocks and bolts; cavities change its load path. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Gotthard and the Channel Tunnel are comparisons of geological and groundwater boundaries only. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.
